title: French Hash Browns
description: A simple and delicious French-inspired dish featuring crispy hash browns. The silky texture of the potatoes pairs perfectly with the rustic flavors of the Australian hash.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Heat the olive oil in the pan and sauté the diced Australian hash until crispy.
Add the grated Russet potato to the pan and stir to combine with the hash.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are golden brown.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
